request.recipient: Intersect 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund 12 months of Hardware Wallet Maintenance 2026 for Cardano hardware-wallet support, compatibility, tooling, integration support, release support, and vendor-required audits.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,310,960 ada, consisting of 1,272,777 ada for Cardano Hardware Wallet Maintenance & Compatibility Assurance and 38,183 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.

The proposed scope is limited to maintaining hardware-wallet compatibility, security, supporting libraries and tooling, release support, and vendor-required audit work, and is not intended to build a new wallet product.

Continuous maintenance is needed because Cardano protocol evolution, Ledger and Trezor release cycles, and wallet and dApp integration demand create compatibility risk for a security-critical access layer.
The proposer claims funding continuity in 2026 is less costly and less disruptive than waiting for breakage to accumulate and responding after users or integrators lose access.
The proposer states that the proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposer states that the withdrawal does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Intersect will administer the funds using Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts, with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses and a dashboard for community auditing.

The proposal states that oversight will include Intersect administrative controls, milestone-based disbursement controls, and an Oversight Committee of six external entities that verify key administrative actions using on-chain logic.

The proposal discloses prior related treasury and Catalyst funding references for hardware wallet maintenance, Ledger app rewrite, Plutus enhancement, Ledger Live integration, message signing, and security-related projects.
The proposer claims the work aligns with Cardano strategic pillars for security, interoperability, developer experience, adoption, and secure user experience.

summary: The document describes a 1,310,960 ada Intersect-submitted treasury withdrawal for 2026 hardware-wallet maintenance, with a high-level budget, scope, governance process references, smart-contract administration details, and oversight structure, but the deterministic assessment notes missing complete summary, budget, feasibility, risk, alternatives, and failure-mode analysis.
